source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 12 mathematics textbooks (advanced stream)

stages.headline: F is an antiderivative of f on an interval if F'(x) = f(x) there; x³ is an antiderivative of 3x².
stages.headlineEnglish: F is an antiderivative of f on an interval if F'(x) = f(x) there; x³ is an antiderivative of 3x².

stages.headline: If F is an antiderivative of f, so is F + C for every constant C, and there are no others.
stages.headlineEnglish: If F is an antiderivative of f, so is F + C for every constant C, and there are no others.

stages.headline: Table of antiderivatives: xⁿ → xⁿ⁺¹/(n + 1), 1/x → ln |x|, eˣ → eˣ, sin x → −cos x, cos x → sin x.
stages.headlineEnglish: Table of antiderivatives: xⁿ → xⁿ⁺¹/(n + 1), 1/x → ln |x|, eˣ → eˣ, sin x → −cos x, cos x → sin x.
